title: Seal a qualified immutable release candidate
description: Bind the exact reviewed/prepared source, generated build inputs, artifacts, profile, configuration, and observed qualification into a retained candidate identity suitable for specific approval and later execution.
inputs: Reviewed source, permitted prepared-source changes, profile and notes.
Actual archives, derived bundled metadata/index, packed CLI bytes, selected destinations/path/configuration, and qualification evidence.
outputs: Immutable retained candidate set and concise exact-identity approval summary.
Mismatch, incomplete dependency, unexpected change, or stale qualification findings.
behavior: Preserve the distinction between reviewed source and permitted deterministic prepared source and expose their allowed differences.
Bind archive bytes before their generated metadata/index and consuming CLI package; create outer candidate identity only after final artifacts and checks exist.
Exclude self-referential digest inputs and keep later public observations outside sealed candidate content.
Expose every material identity, destination, execution path, qualification limit, and required approval subject.
Invalidate affected candidate reliance when source, overlay, artifact, metadata, configuration, or other material input changes.

failure_behavior.condition: Candidate dependencies or observed checks do not refer to the same final artifact basis.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold a qualified sealed-candidate claim and identify the mismatch.

failure_behavior.condition: Unexplained source/overlay changes or missing final bytes remain.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the incomplete or unsupported candidate for correction before approval.
